descriptions.text: The Gradient Market Maker Pool prices the GRAY token and computes LP shares using the spot price of a Uniswap V2 GRAY/WETH pool, with no TWAP or manipulation resistance. The attacker took a 3 WETH Morpho flash loan, swapped WETH for a large amount of GRAY on Uniswap (skewing the spot reserves), and then called provideLiquidity() with ETH and the cheaply-acquired GRAY. Because the pool valued the deposited GRAY using the just-manipulated spot price, the attacker was minted far more LP shares than the true value of their deposit; withdrawLiquidity() then returned more ETH/value than was put in. The funds were used to repay the flash loan with a profit. Root cause: liquidity valuation depends on a manipulable in-block AMM spot price. Attack Tx: https://etherscan.io/tx/0xb5cfa3f86ce9506e2364475dc43c44de444b079d4752edbffcdad7d1654b1f67 Analysis: DeFiMon alert
